verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows DeepSeek offers API/SDK compatibility with OpenAI/Anthropic and integration with third-party CLI tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode) as a backend, plus a 'DeepSeek Harness' in developer preview, but there is no mention of an official DeepSeek-branded CLI tool for interacting with the platform. Missing for 10: an official first-party CLI binary/tool, its documentation, installation instructions, and any independent corroboration of its use.
